sources.title: MiniMax H3 — Video AI Model by MiniMax | Layer
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 (Hailuo-03) is the next-generation open-weight multimodal video model from MiniMax, producing 2K clips at 24 FPS with native stereo audio generated in the same pass. It supports text-to-video and image-to-video with optional first-to-last frame control, durations from 5 to 15 seconds, and six aspect ratios from 21:9 to 9:16.
